title: Import/Export Coordinator
description:
Import/Export Coordinator

About the Role

We are looking for an organised and detail-oriented Import/Export Coordinator to support international shipping operations and ensure compliance with UK customs regulations. This role is responsible for managing export documentation, coordinating with freight forwarders and customs brokers, and supporting the smooth movement of goods into and out of the UK.
Looking for a role where your logistics and import/export experience can truly make an impact? Join a growing business offering real career progression, a modern workplace, and the opportunity to be part of a dynamic global operation. I want to hear from you!
Key Responsibilities
- Monitor and review export reporting ensuring customs compliance.
- Liaise with freight forwarders to obtain proof of export and customs documentation.
- Maintain accurate export records and documentation for goods shipped internationally.
- Ensure all import and export activities comply with HMRC requirements.
- Provide support with import clearance instructions for customs brokers and freight forwarding partners when required.
- Take ownership of shipping invoices and support cost-effective freight operations.
- Coordinate with internal departments and external logistics providers to ensure efficient delivery of goods.

Skills & Experience Required
- Knowledge of import/export processes, customs regulations, and international shipping documentation.
- Experience working with freight forwarders, customs brokers, or logistics providers.
- Strong planning, organisational, and administrative skills.
- Proficient in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel.
- Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal.
- Strong customer service skills with the ability to build effective working relationships.
- Ability to manage multiple priorities and work accurately under pressure.

What's Needed to Succeed
- High attention to detail and accuracy.
- Strong problem-solving skills.
- Ability to work collaboratively across departments.
- A proactive approach and willingness to take ownership of tasks.

What you'll get in return
Hours are 730 until 4pm with a 12 o clock finish on a Friday.

Employee Assistant Programme
Free Parking
Employee discount on products
Canteen on site

Undertake a variety of administrative duties to assist in the smooth running of the Practice including the provision of clerical support to clinical staff and other members of the Practice team Facilitate effective communication between patients, members of the primary health care team, secondary care, and other associated healthcare agencies. Duties and Responsibilities: The duties and responsibilities to be undertaken by members of the Practice Reception & Administration team may include any or all of the items in the following list. Duties may be varied from time to time under the direction of the Reception Team Leader/ Management team, dependent on current and evolving Practice workload and staffing levels: Monitoring the Practice appointments system Processing in person and telephone requests for appointments, visits and telephone consultations and ensuring callers are directed to the appropriate healthcare professional Processing and distributing incoming (and outgoing) mail Taking messages and passing on information Filing and retrieving paperwork Computer data entry/data allocation and collation; processing and recording information in accordance with Practice procedures Initiating contact with and responding to requests from patients, other team members and associated healthcare agencies and providers Clearing and re-stocking consulting rooms as required Providing clerical assistance to Practice Staff as required from time to time, including data processing, filing, and photocopying Provision of refreshments for staff and visitors as required, keeping the kitchen area clean and tidy Keeping the reception area, noticeboards, and leaflet dispensers tidy and up to date and free from obstructions and clutter Scanning of Practice Mail Preparation of lab requests for Phlebotomy Assisting in the recall processes Returning temporary resident/immediately necessary forms to HA after they have expired Processing and taking action on patient notes (PNs posted on clinical computer system) Opening up/locking-up of practice premises and maintaining security in accordance with practice protocols Processing and preparation of prescriptions for patients for signature and authorisation by GPs Dealing with queries relating to prescriptions General housekeeping Attending practice meetings Completing statutory and mandatory learning
